about.title: About SKY130 Analog Lab
about.body: An analog IC lab in the browser. ngspice runs as WebAssembly with SkyWater SKY130 transistor models. No installation, no backend.
about.limits: Limits: only nfet_01v8, pfet_01v8 and pfet_01v8_hvt are real SKY130 devices. Resistors, capacitors, sources and BJTs in lessons are ideal SPICE elements.
